description:
Match a person to birth and death records

Searches the genealogical dataset by exact name and birth year and returns the Open Archives URIs of birth records, death records and registrations in which the person is mentioned.
name: match_record

items.description: A single match result linking a person to a record URI.

archive.description: Name of the archive in the requested language.

eventplace.description: Place(s) where the event occurred, as an array of place names; null when unknown.

eventtype.description: Type of the event in the requested language.

uri.description: Open Archives URI for the matching record.

title: Match Record
